title: Chargers suddenly face must-win game Week 2 vs. Raiders, with a brutal schedule after that

sources.title: Chargers suddenly face must-win game Week 2 vs. Raiders, with a brutal schedule after that
sources.description: The Chargers laid an egg in Week 1 against the Cardinals, and their schedule is about to get much tougher. That's why they can't start 0-2.
